description.value:
A mystical weapon enhancement that channels aether energy to enhance combat prowess. This modification adapts to your fighting style, granting both passive bonuses and powerful active abilities.

Daily Choice

On each long rest, choose one of three combat stances:

  • Aggressive Stance: +2 to attack rolls and +2 to damage rolls
  • Defensive Stance: +2 to AC
  • Balanced Stance: +1 to attack rolls and +1 to damage rolls

Aether-Powered Abilities

Each stance grants a unique ability that costs 1 aether fuel to activate:

  • Extra Attack (Aggressive): Make one additional weapon attack as part of your Attack action this turn
  • Battle Cry (Defensive): All allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn
  • Elemental Strike (Balanced): Your next melee attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of your chosen type (fire, cold, lightning, or thunder)

Temporary Fighting Style

When you choose your stance during a long rest, you may also temporarily learn one fighting style you don't already know (Archery, Defense, Great Weapon Fighting, or Two-Weapon Fighting). This benefit lasts until your next long rest.

Requirements

Requires attunement by a fighter of at least 3rd level.

Complete a long rest to choose your stance and gain access to your ability.
